title: Deputy Chairman and Deputy Speaker Salaries Allowances and Privileges Amendment Act 1985

sections.shortTitle: Deputy Chairman and Deputy Speaker Salaries Allowances and Privileges Amendment Act 1985
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT III OF 1985
ACT III OF 1985
DEPUTY CHAIRMAN AND DEPUTY SPEAKER (SALARIES, ALLOWANCES AND
PRIVILEGES) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1985
An Act further to amend the Deputy Chairman and Deputy Speaker
(Salaries, Allowances and Privileges Act, 1975
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part II, 1st July, 1985]
1. Short title and commencement.-----(1) This Act may be called the Deputy Chairman and Deputy Speaker
(Salaries, Allowances and Privi leges) (Amendment) Act, 1985.
(2) It shall come into force at once and shall be deemed to have taken
effect on the first day of March, 1985.

PRIVILEGES) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1985

(Salaries, Allowances and Privileges Act, 1975
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part II, 1st July, 1985]
2. Amendment of section 3, Act LXXXIII of 1975.------In the Deputy Chairman and Deputy Speaker
(Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975 (LXXXIII of 1975), hereinafter
referred to as the said Act, in section 3, for the words "three thousand
rupees" the words "six thousand rupees" shall be substituted.

sections.shortTitle: Deputy Chairman and Deputy Speaker Salaries Allowances and Privileges Amendment Act 1985
sections.description:
Amendment of section 8, Act LXXXIII of 1975

ACT III OF 1985
ACT III OF 1985
DEPUTY CHAIRMAN AND DEPUTY SPEAKER (SALARIES, ALLOWANCES AND
PRIVILEGES) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1985
An Act further to amend the Deputy Chairman and Deputy Speaker
(Salaries, Allowances and Privileges Act, 1975
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part II, 1st July, 1985]
5. Amendment of section 8, Act LXXXIII of 1975.-----In the said Act, in section 8,-
(a) in subsection (1), for the proviso the following shall be
substituted, namely :-
"Provided that half of the electricity and gas charges in excess of
seven hundred and fifty rupees per mensem shall be paid by the Deputy Chairman,
or as the case may be, the Deputy Speaker."
(b) after subsection (1), amended as aforesaid, the following new
sub-section shall be inserted, namely :-
"(1A) The assessed rent of a house hired for the use of the Deputy
Chairman or the Deputy Speaker shall in no case exceed seven thousand rupees
per mensem." ;
(c) in subsection (2), for the words "twenty thousand rupees"
the words "fifty thousand rupees" shall be substituted ;
(d) in subsection (3), for the words "one thousand rupees" the
words "seven thousand rupees" shall be substituted ; and
(e) in subsection (4) for the words "one thousand rupees" the
words "seven thousand rupees" shall be substituted.

sections.description:

(Salaries, Allowances and Privileges Act, 1975
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part II, 1st July, 1985]
6. Amendment of section 9, Act LXXXIII of 1975.---In the said Act, in section 9,-
(a) in subsection (2) in clause (b), for the words "fifty
rupees" the words "one hundred and fifty rupees", and for the
words "twenty-five rupees" the words "seventy-five rupees",
shall be substituted ;
(b) in subsection (3), in clause (b), for the words "fifty
rupees" the words "one hundred and fifty rupees", and for the
words "twenty five rupees" the words "seventy-five rupees",
shall be substituted ; and
(c) in subsection (5), for the words "one rupee per mile" the
words "two rupees per kilometre", for the words "seventy-five
paisa per mile the words "one rupee and fifty paisa per kilometre",
and for the words "fifty rupees" the words "one hundred and
fifty rupees", shall be substituted.
